claims.claim: A Promise represents the eventual completion or failure of an asynchronous operation and its resulting value.
A promise begins pending and can become fulfilled or rejected; a settled promise is no longer pending.
then() registers fulfillment handling, catch() registers rejection handling, and then() returns a new promise for chaining.
An async function call always returns a new Promise; a returned value fulfills that promise and an uncaught thrown error rejects it.
await pauses evaluation of its surrounding async function until its operand settles, producing the fulfillment value or throwing the rejection reason.
Promise.all fulfills with results in input order when all input promises fulfill, and rejects if an input promise rejects.
